description: Copilot governance rules — evaluated by the governance-audit hook on every tool call

blastRadiusLevels.LOW: Single file, no runtime impact — proceed autonomously
blastRadiusLevels.MEDIUM: Multi-file or config change — proceed, summarise changes
blastRadiusLevels.HIGH: Cross-service, breaking, or hard-to-reverse — explain first
blastRadiusLevels.CRITICAL: Irreversible, multi-system, or credential-touching — stop and get approval

rules.name: No pipe-to-shell downloads
rules.description: curl/wget output piped directly into an interpreter is a code execution vector

rules.name: No credential exfiltration
rules.description: POST requests referencing local credentials, tokens, or config files

rules.name: No obfuscated shell expansion
rules.description: ${var@P} and ${!var} patterns are prompt injection vectors

rules.name: Protect home directory
rules.description: rm -rf ~ or /Users/<user> destroys the entire environment

rules.name: Protect critical directories
rules.description: Recursive delete of .copilot, sovereign, copilot-config, eroad-brain, IdeaProjects requires explicit approval

rules.name: No force push
rules.description: git push --force rewrites shared history — requires explicit human decision

rules.name: No destructive DB operations
rules.description: DROP TABLE/DATABASE or TRUNCATE TABLE must be explicitly approved

rules.name: No download to executable paths
rules.description: Downloading directly to /bin, /usr/local/bin, or .sh/.py files prevents silent code injection

rules.name: Log all destructive file operations
rules.description: rm -rf on non-critical paths is allowed but logged as HIGH

rules.name: Log all VCS writes
rules.description: git commit, push, rebase, reset — logged as MEDIUM

rules.name: Log all file writes
rules.description: edit/create tool calls — logged as MEDIUM
